statements.t: We are also evaluating alternative opportunities in the seniors housing and care sector that we believe will contribute to earnings and shareholder value.
Going forward, we expect our primary sources of cash to be rental revenues and equity-method investment distributions.

For the foreseeable future, we expect our primary uses of cash to be for funding future acquisitions, operating expenses, interest expense on outstanding indebtedness and the repayment of principal on loans payable.

Our liquidity will increase if cash from operations exceeds expenses, we receive net proceeds from the sale of whole or partial interest in a property or properties, or refinancing results in excess loan proceeds.
Our liquidity will decrease as proceeds are expended in connection with our acquisitions and operation of properties.

estimates.t: There have been no material changes to our critical accounting policies as previously disclosed in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 as filed with the SEC on March 27, 2026.
